sentences.en: American politics as a whole are skewed to the right.
sentences.zh: 整体而言，美国政治偏向右倾。

sentences.en: The ruler was slightly skewed, so I adjusted it.
sentences.zh: 尺子歪斜了一点，所以我调整了一下。

sentences.en: His opinion on the matter is somewhat skewed by his personal interests.
sentences.zh: 他对这件事的看法有点被个人利益扭曲了。

senses.zh: 斜交的(不对称的；误解的)
